_about: The fixed grip every fixed-grip chair carries (liftkit.parts.fixed_grip): our own design, sized from the lift drawings' end and plan views and shaped after photographs of fixed grips in service. Millimetres, in the chair frame: origin on the rope's axis at the grip's middle, u along the rope, v outboard, w up.
_adjust: the black jaw blades follow the photographs and the owner's review: about 300 mm each way over the top half of the rope only, just wider than it, their tops flaring up toward the jaw block; the drawings show the clamp's core only
no bolt head inboard of the rope (the owner's review)

the neck and housing are one cast arm swelling from the jaw into the housing, and the hanger flows out of its underside through a socket joined to the hanger's own tube, in place of the drawn boot (the owner's review, after the photographs); castings in the hanger's silver, the collar ring and the bolt's end dark, as photographed

body._note: the jaw block on the rope, a chamfered block

tails._note: the black jaw blades over the top half of the rope: arches from the rope's sides (w from) over the top (w to), half-width v

housing._note: one cast arm and housing from inside the jaw block out to the collar: (radius, v) turned round the stack's axis, 8-sided

socket._note: the housing flows down into the hanger, which starts w below the rope; the funnel's top is an ellipse inside the housing at the stack's axis

spring._note: the spring housing: a shoulder, then the full diameter

bolt._note: the bolt's threaded end past the nut
